published_reference_cross_check.source: Zurbuchen et al. (2013) Annals of Biomedical Engineering

finding: Detailed energy model with explicit harvest/storage/load/duty-cycle profiles. P50 uptime PASSES 95% threshold. Harvest assumption (10μW) within published cardiac harvesting range (5-50μW) — Zurbuchen 2013 measured 16.7μW in-vivo.
what_this_validates: The MODEL ASSUMPTIONS (not just the code) are now testable. Cardiac harvesting at 10μW is in the published range. The model survives this assumption test.
what_this_does_NOT_validate: Actual physical measurement. Would require bench prototype with cardiac harvesting module. Article XXXIV — reality is the next bottleneck.
